title: PPIA-13 Integrated Teaching Workflow Reference Cases

cases.name: first launch to rediscovery
cases.expected: First launch resolves authorized role/workspace, persists only teaching progress, and Help remains rediscoverable after completion or dismissal.

cases.name: role change contracts teaching
cases.expected: Switching to a narrower role invalidates protected teaching derivatives and recomputes the catalog without hidden-topic leakage.

cases.name: campaign join and resume
cases.expected: Campaign join teaching uses only visible membership/role data, stores a teaching bookmark, and resumes without enumerating unavailable Campaigns.

cases.name: resume after revoked membership
cases.expected: A saved resume target is re-authorized; revoked membership contracts the lesson and returns safely without revealing the former Campaign state.

cases.name: character creation to inspector
cases.expected: Character creation help opens a source-grounded Inspector topic and returns to the exact creation context without inventing Character mechanics.

cases.name: source provenance gap
cases.expected: Inspector distinguishes canonical source-backed facts, advisory teaching, and unresolved source gaps without silently substituting generic rules.

cases.name: gm authoring contextual academy
cases.expected: GM authoring offers a short optional source-backed Academy tip and a deeper module while preserving the Campaign/Scene/Session authority boundary.

cases.name: assistant gm delegation expiry
cases.expected: Assistant-GM teaching contracts immediately when delegation expires; Academy craft remains optional and protected Campaign details disappear.

cases.name: first action proposal path
cases.expected: Player teaching distinguishes preview, submitted proposal, pending decision and committed result; no preview is presented as authoritative.

cases.name: first action help replay
cases.expected: Replaying the first-action lesson changes no gameplay state and retains safe Help access from the current Action context.

cases.name: gm approval and player status
cases.expected: GM and Player receive role-distinct approval teaching while pending, decision evidence and accepted durable Event remain separate.

cases.name: modify approve teaching boundary
cases.expected: Modify-and-approve guidance explains the governed sequence without committing anything before the owning approval system accepts it.

cases.name: hidden search and empty state
cases.expected: Filtering precedes search, counts, ranking, autocomplete, examples and empty-state text so protected candidates cannot be inferred.

cases.name: revocation during help
cases.expected: When visibility is revoked mid-help, cached derivatives invalidate and the safe return path neither confirms nor describes protected content.

cases.name: ambiguous progress write recovery
cases.expected: A status-unknown P13-MUT-001 write is resolved by operation_id lookup before retry; duplicate intent never creates a second progress mutation.

cases.name: offline then reconnect
cases.expected: Offline reads may use authorized cache and local pending teaching intent, but authoritative progress advances only after reconnect and durable acceptance.

cases.name: tutorial campaign player gm
cases.expected: Synthetic tutorial Campaign drives Player and GM branches through Character, Action and approval lessons without becoming canonical Campaign truth.

cases.name: tutorial restart idempotency
cases.expected: Restart/replay resets only tutorial teaching progress and never replays authoritative game Effects or promotes fixture content.

cases.name: academy foundations progression
cases.expected: GM Foundations and Intermediate modules progress deterministically, remain replayable and grant no role, permission or feature capability.

cases.name: combat craft grounding
cases.expected: Encounter-design craft links to canonical combat/Encounter Lab sources and remains distinct from legality, balance and rules authority.

cases.name: advanced academy worldbuilding
cases.expected: Advanced/Worldbuilding lessons may create drafts and exercises but never canonicalize generated worlds, cultures, Species facts or setting truth.

cases.name: world creation table provenance
cases.expected: World Creation table output is labeled synthetic prompt material and preserves provenance through save, resume and export.

cases.name: grounded multiversal lesson
cases.expected: A Multiversal Academy topic renders factual instruction only when canonical grounding sources support each Multiversal-specific claim.

cases.name: outline only gap
cases.expected: An unsupported outline heading remains an explicit curriculum gap; search and Inspector never fabricate a lesson from generic RPG knowledge.

cases.name: pack context bounded teaching
cases.expected: Pack teaching exposes only evidenced source/version/lock/entitlement concepts and identifies P13-GAP-001 without inventing F024 lifecycle controls.

cases.name: pack academy reference
cases.expected: Academy material mentioning Packs routes to the same source gap and cannot introduce migration/install/update semantics absent owning authority.

cases.name: glossary source grounded reference
cases.expected: Glossary/reference preserves stable source identity, provenance class and advisory-vs-canonical labels across browse/search/inspect.

cases.name: known limitation return context
cases.expected: A known-limitation topic can hand back to the exact caller context without using hidden-state existence as explanatory evidence.

cases.name: diagnostic support safe handoff
cases.expected: Support handoff includes only allowlisted/redacted diagnostics and safe state categories; secrets and protected payloads remain excluded.

cases.name: p14 wording boundary
cases.expected: Troubleshooting explains state meaning and safe next-step category while leaving final permission/recovery/error wording to PPIA-14.

cases.name: dismiss replay bookmark lifecycle
cases.expected: Dismiss, snooze, replay and bookmark writes affect only teaching presentation/progress and remain versioned/idempotent.

cases.name: optional reset scope
cases.expected: Resetting optional teaching or Academy progress never changes game state, permissions, achievements, canonical content or role capability.

cases.name: cross modality semantic parity
cases.expected: Keyboard, touch, screen-reader, high-zoom, reduced-motion and noncolor modes preserve the same lesson state, warnings, actions and completion evidence.

cases.name: zero ai parity
cases.expected: Optional AI receives only the filtered teaching projection; disabling AI preserves all required teaching facts and actions.

cases.name: service actor minimum projection
cases.expected: Service actors receive only narrow contract metadata needed for storage/intake/notification/export and never human hidden teaching content.

cases.name: admin ai delegation revocation
cases.expected: Owner-admin, AI and delegated assistant projections remain subject to the initiating authorization context and contract immediately on revocation.
